        "sku_to_item_number",

        "ITEM_NUMBERS",

    )

        try:
            module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
        except ImportError:
            continue

            if callable(lookup):
                return lookup
        for name in mapping_names:
            mapping = getattr(module, name, None)
            if isinstance(mapping, Mapping):
                return mapping.__getitem__
    return None

            if callable(lookup):

        for name in mapping_names:

            if isinstance(mapping, Mapping):

    """Return the finance-system item number for ``sku``.

    The finance system owns the SKU-to-item-number mapping.  The lookup is
